blocks.text: **see, hear, watch, notice, feel, listen to, smell** kabi his fe'llaridan keyin to'ldiruvchi (kimdir yoki nimadir) va yana bir fe'l keladi. Bu fe'l ikki shaklda bo'ladi: **to'siz infinitiv** (I saw him **leave**) yoki **-ing** (I saw him **leaving**). **to** ishlatilmaydi: «I saw him to leave» — xato. O'zbekchada farq juda aniq: «...**gan**ini ko'rdim» (to'liq harakat) va «...**yotgan**ini ko'rdim» (jarayon). Asosiy savol: siz harakatni **boshidan oxirigacha** ko'rdingizmi yoki uning **bir qismini**?

To'siz infinitiv harakat **tugallanganini** va siz uni to'liq kuzatganingizni ko'rsatadi. Ko'pincha qisqa, bir martalik harakatlar yoki ketma-ket harakatlar zanjiri: I watched her **open** the box, **take** out the ring and **put** it on. Mantiqan bu Past Simple ga o'xshaydi: She opened the box (va men buni ko'rdim) → I saw her **open** the box.

items.text: I saw the thief **climb** over the fence and **run** away.
items.translation: O'g'rining devordan **oshib o'tib, qochib ketganini** ko'rdim.

items.text: We watched the plane **take off** and **disappear** into the clouds.
items.translation: Samolyotning **ko'tarilib, bulutlar orasida g'oyib bo'lganini** kuzatdik.

blocks.text: **-ing** shakli harakatni **jarayonda** ko'rganingizni bildiradi: u siz ko'rgunga qadar boshlangan va ehtimol keyin ham davom etgan, siz faqat bir bo'lagini ko'rdingiz. Mantiqan bu Past Continuous ga o'xshaydi: He was walking along the river (va men uni shu payt ko'rdim) → I saw him **walking** along the river. Uzoq davom etadigan harakatlar bilan -ing tabiiyroq: I could hear people **talking** next door.

items.text: I saw Aziz **waiting** at the bus stop this morning.
items.translation: Bugun ertalab Azizning bekatda **kutib turganini** ko'rdim.

items.text: When I came home, I found the children **watching** cartoons.
items.translation: Uyga kelsam, bolalar multfilm **ko'rib o'tirishgan ekan**.

rows: I saw him **cross** the road. (u yoqdan bu yoqqa — hammasini)
I saw him **crossing** the road. (yo'lning o'rtasida edi)
I heard her **sing** a song at the wedding. (boshidan oxirigacha)
I heard her **singing** in the shower. (bir qismini)
We watched them **build** the wall. (ish tugaguncha)
We watched them **building** the wall. (bir muddat)

blocks.text: Qisqa harakatlar, takror, smell va could

Qisqa, bir lahzalik harakatda (slam, fall, explode, shout) odatda **do**: I heard a glass **break**. Agar u **takrorlansa** — **-ing**: I heard someone **knocking** (bir necha marta taqillatdi). **smell**, **find** va **catch** deyarli faqat -ing bilan: I can **smell** something **burning**; The teacher **caught** him **cheating**. **can / could + see / hear / smell / feel** ko'pincha -ing bilan keladi: I **could feel** the ground **shaking**. **feel** bilan ikkalasi ham bo'ladi: I felt something **touch / touching** my arm.

items.text: Suddenly we heard something **explode** in the street.
I can smell something **burning** — did you leave the oven on?
items.translation: Nimadir **kuyayotgan** hid kelyapti — duxovkani o'chirmay qoldirdingmi?

items.text: Nilufar felt her phone **vibrating** in her pocket during the lecture.
items.translation: Ma'ruza paytida Nilufar cho'ntagida telefoni **titrayotganini** sezdi.

blocks.text: Majhul nisbatda (→ 42-dars) **to** qaytib keladi: They saw him **leave** → He **was seen to leave**. -ing esa o'zgarmaydi: He **was seen leaving** the building. Yangiliklarda ko'p uchraydi: The suspect **was last seen walking** towards the station — Gumonlanuvchi oxirgi marta vokzal tomon **ketayotganida ko'rilgan**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) to qo'shish: «I saw him to go» → I saw him **go** / **going**. (2) fe'lni tuslash: «I heard her sings», «I watched them played» → her **sing**, them **play**. (3) that-gap bilan aralashtirish: «I saw that he was crossing» — bu «tushundim, bildim» ma'nosiga yaqin; ko'z bilan ko'rganlik — I saw him **crossing**. (4) olmosh shakli: «I saw he leave» → I saw **him** leave (→ qizil kitob, 59-dars).

O'zbekcha bilan tekshiring: «...**gan**ini ko'rdim / eshitdim» → **do**; «...**yotgan**ini ko'rdim / eshitdim» → **doing**. Hid kelyapti, sezib turibman, ustida ushlab oldim (smell, feel, catch) — deyarli doim **doing**.

rows: I saw her **get** into a taxi.
I saw her **standing** at the window.
I smelt gas **leaking**. She caught him **reading** her messages.

examples.title: **see** somebody **do**: the whole action
examples.description: see / watch + kimdir + to'siz infinitiv: harakatni boshidan oxirigacha ko'rdingiz — «...ganini ko'rdim».

sentences.text: I saw the bus driver **close** the doors and **drive** off without us.
sentences.translation: Avtobus haydovchisining eshiklarni **yopib, bizsiz jo'nab ketganini** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: Did anyone see the boy **break** the window?
sentences.translation: Bolaning derazani **sindirganini** kimdir ko'rdimi?

sentences.text: We watched the sun **rise** over the mountains near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Chimyon yaqinidagi tog'lar ortidan quyosh **chiqqanini** tomosha qildik.

sentences.text: Madina saw her neighbour **leave** the house at six and **lock** the gate.
sentences.translation: Madina qo'shnisining soat oltida uydan **chiqib, darvozani qulflaganini** ko'rdi.

sentences.text: Have you ever seen a chef **make** noodles by hand?
sentences.translation: Oshpazning qo'lda lag'mon **cho'zganini** hech ko'rganmisiz?

sentences.text: The guard saw two men **get** out of a black car.
sentences.translation: Qorovul ikki erkakning qora mashinadan **tushganini** ko'rdi.

sentences.text: Everybody watched the bride **cut** the wedding cake.
sentences.translation: Hamma kelinning to'y tortini **kesganini** tomosha qildi.

sentences.text: I've never seen Jasur **lose** his temper before.
sentences.translation: Jasurning **jahli chiqqanini** ilgari hech ko'rmaganman.

sentences.text: Thousands of fans watched Bekzod **score** the winning goal in the final minute.
sentences.translation: Minglab muxlislar Bekzodning so'nggi daqiqada g'alaba golini **urganini** tomosha qilishdi.

sentences.text: Let me watch you **do** it once, and then I'll try it myself.
sentences.translation: Bir marta siz **qilganingizni** ko'rib olay, keyin o'zim urinib ko'raman.

examples.title: **see** somebody **doing**: in the middle of it
examples.description: see / watch / notice + kimdir + -ing: harakatning bir qismini, jarayonda ko'rdingiz — «...yotganini ko'rdim».

sentences.text: I saw Emma **jogging** in the park when I was driving to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga mashinada ketayotib, Emmaning bog'da **yugurayotganini** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: Look! Can you see those people **climbing** the cliff?
sentences.translation: Qara! Qoyaga **tirmashib chiqayotgan** odamlarni ko'ryapsanmi?

sentences.text: When I passed the café, I noticed Aziz **sitting** alone by the window.
sentences.translation: Kafe yonidan o'tayotib, Azizning deraza yonida yolg'iz **o'tirganini** payqadim.

sentences.text: We stood on the bridge and watched the boats **sailing** down the river.
sentences.translation: Ko'prikda turib, daryo bo'ylab **suzib ketayotgan** qayiqlarni tomosha qildik.

sentences.text: Kate saw a man **trying** to open her car door and called the police.
sentences.translation: Keyt bir erkakning mashinasi eshigini **ochishga urinayotganini** ko'rib, politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: This morning I saw the kids **building** a snowman in the yard.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab bolalarning hovlida qordan odam **yasayotganini** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: Oliver spent an hour in the square watching the old men **playing** chess.
sentences.translation: Oliver maydonda bir soat qariyalarning shaxmat **o'ynayotganini** tomosha qildi.

sentences.text: From my office window I can see workers **repairing** the roof opposite.
sentences.translation: Ofisim derazasidan ro'paradagi tomni **ta'mirlayotgan** ishchilarni ko'ra olaman.

sentences.text: Nilufar spotted her ex-boyfriend **queuing** at the cinema and quickly turned away.
sentences.translation: Nilufar sobiq yigitining kinoteatrda **navbatda turganini** ko'rib qolib, darhol teskari o'girildi.

sentences.text: The security camera filmed someone **walking** around the building at three in the morning.
sentences.translation: Kuzatuv kamerasi tungi soat uchda kimningdir binoni aylanib **yurganini** yozib oldi.

examples.title: **hear** somebody **do** / **doing**
examples.description: hear / listen to + kimdir + do (to'liq eshitdingiz) yoki doing (bir qismini, jarayonda eshitdingiz).

sentences.text: I heard someone **shout** my name, but when I turned round, nobody was there.
sentences.translation: Kimdir ismimni **chaqirganini** eshitdim, lekin o'girilganimda hech kim yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Can you hear the neighbours **arguing** again?
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarning yana **janjallashayotganini** eshityapsanmi?

sentences.text: We heard the pilot **announce** that we were about to land.
sentences.translation: Uchuvchining samolyot qo'nish arafasida ekanini **e'lon qilganini** eshitdik.

sentences.text: Late at night Dilnoza heard somebody **walking** around downstairs.
sentences.translation: Kech tunda Dilnoza pastki qavatda kimdir **yurayotganini** eshitdi.

sentences.text: Have you ever heard Madina **sing**? She has a beautiful voice.
sentences.translation: Madinaning **qo'shiq aytganini** hech eshitganmisiz? Ovozi juda chiroyli.

sentences.text: I could hear my parents **talking** quietly in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning oshxonada past ovozda **gaplashayotgani** eshitilib turardi.

sentences.text: Nobody heard the alarm **go** off because everyone was asleep.
sentences.translation: Hamma uxlab yotgani uchun signal **chalinganini** hech kim eshitmadi.

sentences.text: We listened to the old man **tell** stories about Samarkand in the 1960s.
sentences.translation: Qariyaning 1960-yillardagi Samarqand haqida **hikoya qilganini** tingladik.

sentences.text: Did you hear Bekzod **come** in last night? It was after midnight.
sentences.translation: Kecha Bekzodning **kirib kelganini** eshitdingmi? Yarim tundan keyin edi.

sentences.text: Through the thin walls Tom could hear the baby next door **crying** all night.
sentences.translation: Yupqa devorlar orqali Tom qo'shni xonadagi chaqaloqning tun bo'yi **yig'layotganini** eshitib chiqdi.

examples.title: **watch**, **notice**, **feel**: complete or in progress
examples.description: watch / notice / feel + kimdir + do yoki doing: kuzatish, payqash va sezish fe'llari bilan ham xuddi shu farq.

sentences.text: Did you notice anybody **leave** the room during the presentation?
sentences.translation: Taqdimot paytida kimdir xonadan **chiqib ketganini** payqadingizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah noticed a strange man **standing** outside her house.
sentences.translation: Sara uyi oldida notanish erkakning **turganini** payqadi.

sentences.text: I felt something **bite** my leg while I was sleeping in the tent.
sentences.translation: Chodirda uxlayotganimda nimadir oyog'imni **chaqqanini** sezdim.

sentences.text: When the train started, Aziz felt the carriage **shaking** under his feet.
sentences.translation: Poyezd jo'naganda Aziz oyog'i ostida vagonning **silkinayotganini** sezdi.

sentences.text: We sat on the balcony and watched the storm **moving** across the valley.
sentences.translation: Balkonda o'tirib, bo'ronning vodiy bo'ylab **siljib kelayotganini** kuzatdik.

sentences.text: The teacher didn't notice Jasur **copy** the answers from his neighbour.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi Jasurning yonidagidan javoblarni **ko'chirib olganini** payqamadi.

sentences.text: Have you ever watched a potter **make** a bowl from start to finish?
sentences.translation: Kulolning kosani boshidan oxirigacha **yasaganini** hech tomosha qilganmisiz?

sentences.text: Emma felt her heart **beating** faster when she walked onto the stage.
sentences.translation: Sahnaga chiqqanda Emma yuragi tezroq **urayotganini** sezdi.

sentences.text: Nobody noticed the cat **slip** out through the open door.
sentences.translation: Mushukning ochiq eshikdan **sirg'alib chiqib ketganini** hech kim payqamadi.

sentences.text: Parents should watch their children **using** the internet, at least at first.
sentences.translation: Ota-onalar, hech bo'lmasa avvaliga, bolalarining internetdan qanday **foydalanayotganini** kuzatib borishi kerak.

examples.title: **can smell** / **could hear** + -ing
examples.description: can / could + see / hear / smell / feel ko'pincha -ing bilan; smell — deyarli doim -ing: I can smell something burning.

sentences.text: I **can smell** something **burning** — is the rice all right?
sentences.translation: Nimadir **kuyayotgan** hid kelyapti — guruch joyidami?

sentences.text: From our hotel room we **could hear** the waves **crashing** on the rocks.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonamizdan to'lqinlarning qoyalarga **urilayotgani** eshitilib turardi.

sentences.text: **Can** you **feel** the wind **getting** stronger?
sentences.translation: Shamol **kuchayib borayotganini** sezyapsizmi?

sentences.text: The firefighters **could smell** gas **leaking** from a broken pipe.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar singan quvurdan gaz **sizib chiqayotganini** hididan bilishdi.

sentences.text: On a clear day you **can see** planes **landing** at the airport from here.
sentences.translation: Ochiq kunda bu yerdan samolyotlarning aeroportga **qo'nayotganini** ko'rish mumkin.

sentences.text: Kate **could feel** everyone **looking** at her when she entered the room.
sentences.translation: Keyt xonaga kirganda hammaning unga **qarab turganini** sezdi.

sentences.text: **Could** you **hear** the guests **singing** at the wedding next door last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha qo'shni to'ydagi mehmonlarning **qo'shiq aytayotganini** eshitdingizmi?

sentences.text: Even with the windows closed, I **can hear** the traffic **roaring** outside.
sentences.translation: Derazalar yopiq bo'lsa ham, tashqarida transportning **guvillayotganini** eshityapman.

sentences.text: Grandma said she **could smell** fresh bread **baking** from the end of the street.
sentences.translation: Buvim ko'chaning boshidanoq yangi non **pishayotganini** hididan bilganini aytdi.

sentences.text: In the silence we **could hear** the clock **ticking** on the wall.
sentences.translation: Jimjitlikda devordagi soatning **chiqillayotgani** eshitilib turardi.

examples.title: Complete or in progress? Contrast pairs
examples.description: Bir xil fe'l ikki shaklda: do — harakat to'liq kuzatildi, doing — faqat bir qismi. Juftliklar farqni his qilish uchun.

sentences.text: I saw Tom **get** into his car and **drive** away.
sentences.translation: Tomning mashinasiga **o'tirib, jo'nab ketganini** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: I saw Tom **getting** into his car, so I didn't stop to talk.
sentences.translation: Tomni mashinasiga **o'tirayotganida** ko'rdim, shuning uchun gaplashgani to'xtamadim.

sentences.text: We watched the workers **build** the new bridge — it took them two years.
sentences.translation: Ishchilarning yangi ko'prikni **qurganini** kuzatib bordik — bunga ikki yil ketdi.

sentences.text: Every morning we watch the workers **building** the new bridge from the bus.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab avtobusdan ishchilarning yangi ko'prik **qurayotganini** kuzatamiz.

sentences.text: Madina heard her son **play** the whole piano piece without a mistake.
sentences.translation: Madina o'g'lining butun pianino asarini xatosiz **chalib berganini** eshitdi.

sentences.text: When she passed the music school, Madina heard someone **playing** the piano.
sentences.translation: Musiqa maktabi yonidan o'tayotib, Madina kimdir pianino **chalayotganini** eshitdi.

sentences.text: Did you see the referee **show** the red card? — No, I was getting a drink.
sentences.translation: Hakam qizil kartochka **ko'rsatganini** ko'rdingmi? — Yo'q, ichimlik olgani ketgan edim.

sentences.text: Did you see Aziz **dancing** at the wedding? He was having so much fun!
sentences.translation: To'yda Azizning **raqsga tushayotganini** ko'rdingmi? Juda maza qilayotgan edi!

sentences.text: Bekzod heard a car **stop** outside, then a door **slam**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tashqarida mashina **to'xtaganini**, keyin eshik **qarsillab yopilganini** eshitdi.

sentences.text: All evening Bekzod heard cars **stopping** outside for the party next door.
sentences.translation: Bekzod butun kechqurun qo'shnidagi bazm uchun tashqarida mashinalar **to'xtayotganini** eshitib turdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a witness to a road accident
examples.description: Suhbat: politsiyachi avariyaning guvohidan nima ko'rgani va eshitganini so'raydi — do va doing navbatma-navbat.

sentences.text: — Officer, I saw the whole thing. I saw the van **hit** the cyclist.
sentences.translation: — Ofitser, men hammasini ko'rdim. Furgonning velosipedchini **urib yuborganini** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: — Did you see the cyclist **coming** from the side street?
sentences.translation: — Velosipedchining yon ko'chadan **kelayotganini** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, I noticed him **riding** quite fast, but he had a green light.
sentences.translation: — Ha, uning ancha tez **haydab kelayotganini** payqadim, lekin unga yashil chiroq yongan edi.

sentences.text: — And the van? Did you see it **stop** at the red light?
sentences.translation: — Furgon-chi? Uning qizil chiroqda **to'xtaganini** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: — No, I didn't see it **slow** down at all. I heard the brakes **screaming**.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, uning umuman **sekinlaganini** ko'rmadim. Tormozlarning **chiyillayotganini** eshitdim.

sentences.text: — Did you hear the driver **say** anything after the crash?
sentences.translation: — To'qnashuvdan keyin haydovchining biror narsa **deganini** eshitdingizmi?

sentences.text: — I heard him **shouting** into his phone, but I couldn't understand the words.
sentences.translation: — Uning telefonda **baqirayotganini** eshitdim, lekin so'zlarini tushunolmadim.

sentences.text: — What about the cyclist? Did you see him **get** up?
sentences.translation: — Velosipedchi-chi? Uning o'rnidan **turganini** ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: — He tried, but I saw him **holding** his arm, so I called an ambulance.
sentences.translation: — Urindi, lekin uning qo'lini **ushlab turganini** ko'rib, tez yordam chaqirdim.

sentences.text: — Thank you. It's lucky that you saw everything **happen** so clearly.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Hammasi qanday **sodir bo'lganini** aniq ko'rganingiz yaxshi bo'libdi.

examples.title: Mixed: news, stories and the passive
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: see / hear / watch / smell / catch + do yoki doing, majhul nisbatda — was seen to leave / was seen leaving.

sentences.text: The missing teenager **was last seen walking** towards the station on Friday.
sentences.translation: Yo'qolgan o'smir oxirgi marta juma kuni vokzal tomon **ketayotganida ko'rilgan**.

sentences.text: Witnesses say they heard two loud bangs and saw smoke **rising** from the factory.
sentences.translation: Guvohlarning aytishicha, ular ikki marta kuchli gumburlashni eshitib, zavoddan tutun **ko'tarilayotganini** ko'rishgan.

sentences.text: The minister **was seen to leave** the building by a back door.
sentences.translation: Vazirning binodan orqa eshik orqali **chiqib ketgani ko'rilgan**.

sentences.text: Have you ever watched the sun **set** over the desert near Khiva?
sentences.translation: Xiva yaqinidagi cho'l ustida quyosh **botganini** hech tomosha qilganmisiz?

sentences.text: James woke up because he could smell smoke **coming** from the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Jeyms oshxonadan tutun **kelayotganini** hididan sezib, uyg'onib ketdi.

sentences.text: Scientists filmed the bears **catching** fish in the river for their documentary.
sentences.translation: Olimlar hujjatli film uchun ayiqlarning daryoda baliq **tutayotganini** suratga olishdi.

sentences.text: I didn't actually see the accident **happen**, but I heard it.
sentences.translation: Avariya qanday **sodir bo'lganini** aslida ko'rmadim, lekin ovozini eshitdim.

sentences.text: The headteacher caught two boys **smoking** behind the gym.
sentences.translation: Maktab direktori ikki o'quvchini sport zali ortida **chekayotgan payti** ushlab oldi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza felt the plane **drop** suddenly and grabbed her husband's hand.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza samolyotning to'satdan **pastlab ketganini** sezib, erining qo'lini mahkam ushladi.

sentences.text: According to reports, the singer **was heard to say** that this would be her last tour.
sentences.translation: Xabarlarga ko'ra, qo'shiqchi bu uning so'nggi gastroli bo'lishini **aytgani eshitilgan**.
